look_here_first: Check a mature middle leaf: triangular/deltate to ovate with a continuous margin bearing teeth but NOT deep lobes or dissections; opposite leaves and blue-violet rayless heads support Conoclinium. Compare C. dissectum's palmately cut foliage.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays project native source; Travis St. Edward's Park/native records; Williamson UT PRC county treatment. Purola's intentionally introduced population is excluded.

best_field_traits: opposite triangular/deltate leaves with 3 strong basal veins
flat-topped to domed array of many small blue-violet heads
heads are discoid: disk florets only, no rays
morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Triangular to deltate, serrate/dentate, strongly 3-veined from base.
morphology_keys.heads: Small blue-violet discoid heads with no ray florets.
morphology_keys.reproductive_confirmation: FNA: corollas usually 2–2.5 mm; cypselae 1–1.5 mm glabrous.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Versus C. dissectum: intact triangular/deltate toothed blades rather than deeply lobed; shorter glabrous 1–1.5 mm cypselae vs longer hispidulous 1.8–2.5 mm. Versus Chromolaena odorata: Conoclinium has short hemispheric involucres, not long cylindrical 8–10 mm ones.
